| Property                            | Description                                                      |
| ----------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------- |
| GUID                                | The GUID associated to the container.                            |
| IsDeleted                           | Whether the container is deleted                                 |
| IsCommercial                        | Is this container for commercial use?                            |
| IsStoplisted                        | Is this container stop listed?                                   |
| TipLocationListItem                 | The GUID and description of the tip location this container is associated to.     |
| ContainerStatusListItem             | The GUID and description of the container status this container is associated to. |
| ContainerTypeListItem               | The GUID and description of the container type this container is associated to. |
| LastChangeReasonListItem            | The GUID and description of the reason this container was last changed.  |
| CompanyOutletListItem               | The GUID and name of the company outlet this container is associated to. |
| Manufacture                         | The container's manufacture information.                           |
| Manufacture.DateOfDelivery          | The container's date of delivery in ISO format (YYYY-MM-DD).       |
| Manufacture.DateOfManufacture       | The container's manufacture date in ISO format (YYYY-MM-DD).       |
| Manufacture.WarrantyEndDate         | The container's warranty end date in ISO format (YYYY-MM-DD).      |
| Manufacture.RelatedSupplierSiteGuid | The GUID of the supplier site related to the manufacturer of the container.|
| Manufacture.RelatedAppliedCostGuid  | The GUID of the applied cost related to the purchase of the container.|
| Geo                                 | The geographical associated to the container.                      |
| Geo.Latitude                        | The geographical latitude associated to the container.             |
| Geo.Longitude                       | The geographical longitude associated to the container.            |
| Note                                | The container's note.                                              |
| SerialNo                            | The container's serial number.                                     |
| Tag                                 | The container's tag.                                               |
